reported_status: The available P1 FCCC47D6 return reports an unsuccessful invention investigation with two worked architectural paths. Electrochemical capture with humidity recuperation does not jointly close water recovery, CO2 crossover, area, power and cost. A four-bed commercial-amine/heat-pump/vacuum candidate is specified with producer-reported executable balance calculations: nominal100h delivers5.89kg/1.41kg per day at7.39kWh/kg, and a favorable hardware sensitivity still needs1.46kWh/kg versus0.50 target. Its conditional production model is about712USD/t versus100USD/t. These failures apply to the examined designs and assumptions, not every separator. No new separator, measured device, achieved invention, novelty or general impossibility is established. Whole ROOT derivations supply ideal separation/airflow/humidity/water-capacity/cost interfaces without constructing the missing joint material or machine. New complete ROOT conditional screens distinguish the outer water-retaining gas barrier from the inner ionic separator; derive an ohmic/backdiffusion inequality, charge/auxiliary thresholds and useful-flux/area/renewal costs. Original ROOT Python and supplied JSON evaluate those formulas, without supplying a simultaneously measured hydrated material or validating the uncollected producer model.
